grokace_witness_signature.algorithm: Ed25519 over the sealed_output bytes (sealed_output hex string encoded UTF-8)
grokace_witness_signature.note: GrokAce's witness seed is fresh and held by GrokAce; only the signature and pubkey are published here. Ace's witness keypair was derived in-run from the deterministic seed sha256(b'live-w-ace-curl-provindex') — a test keypair whose seed is already in the repo, not a production credential.

notes: Both witnesses sealed the identical output; residual 0 (78/78) is the agreement of two independent reads of the same served index.
Blind-witness character: GrokAce read blind, Ace withheld his read; the gate solver re-executed blind a third way.
Signatures re-verified 2026-11-15 (ALL PASS): vault Ed25519 signature valid via vault.py verify; GrokAce witness Ed25519 valid; seal recomputed matches both witnesses.
seal_formula: sha256(canonical_json(output)), where canonical_json is json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded UTF-8

witnesses.implementation: python3.13 urllib + cryptography 43 Ed25519 (RFC 8032) + asinmcp gate.py canonical_json/seal @4742abb, GrokAce box Linux
